package.description: Sovereign AI agents that run 100% on your own machine.

en-US.description: Sovereign AI agents that run 100% on your own machine.
en-US.longDescription:
Locaible deploys private AI agents that run entirely on your own computer.
No data ever leaves your machine — GDPR & EU AI Act compliant by design.
Works with Ollama and Hugging Face models on Windows, macOS and Linux.
en-US.name: Locaible
